text:
Alex: Morning all, first-day MBP enrolled but I'm blocked enabling FileVault. System shows an alert: 'Bootstrap token not available 12 An administrator must enable SecureToken for this user'. macOS 13.5.1. Anyone run into the bootstrap token flow before?

Sam (IT): Welcome Alex  that message usually means your account didn't get a Secure Token at creation (common with SSO-only accounts). Can you run and paste: `sysadminctl -secureTokenStatus $(whoami)` and `fdesetup status`?

Alex: Ran them, outputs:
```
$ sysadminctl -secureTokenStatus alex
User alex does not have Secure Token

$ fdesetup status
FileVault is Off.
No user is enabled for FileVault.
```
I'm on home Wi-Fi, enrolled via Okta device assignment.

Maya (Buddy): @Alex FYI IT gave me a temporary admin once and they used `sysadminctl -secureTokenOn` to grant my account the token, then FV enabled cleanly. Saved me from bringing the laptop in.

Sam (IT): Two supported paths: 1) we create a temporary local admin and run `sysadminctl -adminUser <adm> -adminPassword <pw> -secureTokenOn alex -password <alexPW>` to give you the token (quick), or 2) since your device is supervised we can enable the bootstrap token via MDM and push FileVault enable using the organization's escrow key so you don't have to share creds. Which do you prefer?

Alex: Prefer not to handle admin creds if possible. Please try the bootstrap token via MDM.

Device Bot: Device ID b6e4c1: enrolled=true, supervised=true, bootstrap_token_allowed=true, fv_policy=required. Preparing to push 'Enable Bootstrap Token' and 'Enable FileVault (escrow)'.

Sam (IT): Pushing cert/profile to allow bootstrap token and then the FV escrow command. You should see a modal: "Redwood Device Management requests to enable FileVault using the organization's recovery key". Accept and enter your macOS password. Reboot when asked.

Alex: Got the modal, accepted and entered password. It showed 'Enabling FileVault...' and required a reboot. Rebooted and ran checks:
```
$ fdesetup status
FileVault is On.
Users enabled for FileVault:
 - alex
```
All good now, no more bootstrap errors. Thanks!

Sam (IT): Great  welcome aboard. Closing note for channel: SSO-only accounts may lack Secure Token; prefer MDM bootstrap-token + escrowed FV enable on supervised devices to avoid sharing creds. Filed KB entry.

Maya (Buddy): Nice, glad that was quick  welcome Alex :tada:
